Demographics and baseline characteristics

Source: R/builders-table.R
tbl_demographics.Rd

Stacks continuous blocks (stat_desc()) and categorical blocks (stat_freq()) with big-N column headers. Requested variables missing from the data are skipped and recorded in meta$skipped.

Usage

tbl_demographics(
  adsl,
  trt_var = "TRT01A",
  cont_vars = list(AGE = "Age (years)"),
  cat_vars = list(SEX = "Sex", RACE = "Race", ETHNIC = "Ethnicity", AGEGR1 = "Age group"),
  config = NULL
)

Arguments

adsl

Subject-level data.

trt_var

Treatment variable (resolved with tlf_resolve_trt()).

cont_vars

Named list: continuous variable = row label.

cat_vars

Named list: categorical variable = row label.

config

A tlf_config(); NULL resolves through tlf_get_config().

Value

A tlf_table.

See also

Other table builders: tbl_ae(), tbl_ae_severity(), tbl_disposition(), tbl_eff(), tbl_listing(), tbl_shift(), tbl_tte()

Examples

tbl_demographics(ex_adsl)
#> <tlf_table> 13 row(s) x 6 column(s)
